run_eval_zeroshot: run SLIP zero-shot evaluation on downstream datasets using a pretrained checkpoint
validate_zeroshot: validate a SLIP model with zero-shot classification using image-text cosine similarity
accuracy: compute top-k accuracy over model predictions for a given set of k values
mean_per_class: compute mean per-class accuracy from model outputs and targets using confusion matrix
roc_auc: compute ROC AUC score from binary classification model outputs and targets
